item.title: 100+ Oil Execs Predict Future WTI Oil Prices
item.description: More than 100 oil and gas firm executives revealed where they expect the WTI crude oil price to be at various points in the future in the third quarter Dallas Fed Energy Survey.

item.title: ADNOC to Continue Supplying LNG to Thai Power Developer
item.description: ADNOC signed a new 'multi-year' agreement to supply about two million metric tons per annum of liquefied natural gas to Thai gas-focused electricity developer Gulf starting 2027.

item.title: Centalion buys Silver Hill’s Haynesville natural gas assets
item.description: Centalion, formerly known as Gunvor, has acquired a portfolio of upstream and midstream natural gas assets in Texas and Louisiana from US-based private energy company Silver Hill Energy Partners.

item.title: Baker Hughes signs agreements to support Venezuela energy rebuild
item.description: Baker Hughes has signed two agreements aimed at supporting the redevelopment of Venezuela’s energy infrastructure and expansion of the country’s natural gas sector.

item.title: Brent Once Again Toiling Around $100 Mark
item.description: Brent is once again toiling around $100 per barrel as its reasons for trading much beyond the psychological three-digit mark are being eroded, PVM Oil Associates Analyst John Evans said.

item.title: Tankers Sought as Iraq Pushes On with Hormuz Oil Exports
item.description: Iraq is set to hire additional tankers, with at least two arriving over the next few days as the country looks for greater control over moving its oil through the heavily contested Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Cenovus Energy to acquire Athabasca Oil in $4bn deal
item.description: Canada-based oil sands producer Cenovus Energy has reached a definitive agreement to acquire Athabasca Oil in a cash and stock transaction worth C$5.7bn ($4bn).
